record.name: Gitxsan Forestry Enterprises Inc
record.description: Gitxsan Forest Enterprises Inc (GFEI) manages a forest tenure located in the Kispiox Timber Supply Area (TSA) between Smithers to the east, Terrace to the west, and the headwaters of the Skeena river to the North.      GFEI's timber license predominantly supports the growth of hemlock and balsam fir with an annual allowable cut of approximately 388,000 cubic meters.
